about: Newest Amal wins (Medi M1, 2026-09-29: "use amals"). When Amal later spells the same form differently in the app than on an older Quizlet card, her newer spelling is shown on the card and used by every check. Her imported Quizlet data is never edited; this overlay is applied when the sets are loaded (docs/js/amal-newest.js).
